moodys.citation_text: Moody's press release indexed as 'Rating Action: Moody's assigns A2 to UPMC's (PA) Ser. 2023 and 2023A-1,A-2,B&C; outlook stable' (March 2023). The action both assigned A2 to the new Series 2023 issuances and concurrently AFFIRMED the A2 on UPMC's outstanding bonds and notes, confirming that the rating in effect entering 2023 (i.e., the 2022-12-31 snapshot) was A2 / stable. The Moody's PR landing page is paywalled to anonymous WebFetch (HTTP 403), but the index title and corroborating reporting (Bond Buyer, Becker's, fiercehealthcare.com) consistently describe UPMC's prior Moody's rating going into the March 2023 issuance as A2 stable. UPMC was downgraded by Moody's from Aa3 to A1 in 2017 over the PinnacleHealth acquisition (Becker's: 'Moody's downgrades UPMC to A1'); the further step down to A2 occurred before the snapshot window.

sp.citation_text: Bond Buyer (March 18, 2025), summarizing pre-issuance ratings on UPMC's Series 2025 deal, reports 'S&P: Affirmed A rating with stable outlook' — i.e. S&P's pre-existing rating was A/stable and was reaffirmed. Corroborating: UPMC's bond-ratings-disclosures page hosts S&P letters on Series 2023 bonds at A rating, and multiple secondary sources (fiercehealthcare.com, Becker's) describe S&P's rating on UPMC across the 2023-2025 window as 'A, stable' throughout. No S&P rating action on UPMC was located in the public record between 2022-12-31 and the March 2023 issuance, so the 2022-12-31 snapshot is recorded as A/stable carrying forward into the March 2023 affirmation.

fitch.citation_text: fiercehealthcare.com (March 2023) and corroborating Bond Buyer coverage describe Fitch's action on UPMC's Series 2023 deal as 'assigned an A rating to the anticipated series of 2023 bonds ... and gave a positive rating outlook' — confirming Fitch's pre-existing rating going into 2023 was A and that the outlook was at or revised to positive at the time of the March 2023 deal. Fitch's March 19, 2024 action is subsequently described (Becker's, indexed) as 'revised the health system's outlook from positive to stable,' which independently confirms that the outlook in effect immediately before March 2024 (and thus snapshot date 2022-12-31, since no intervening Fitch action was located) was positive.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Assigned A2 to UPMC's (PA) new Series 2023 and 2023A-1, A-2, B & C bonds; concurrently affirmed the A2 on UPMC's outstanding bonds and notes. Outlook stable.
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's rationale (as quoted in indexed/secondary coverage): 'The assignment and affirmation of the A2 reflects UPMC's formidable market position and demonstrated ability to execute strategies through a centralized management model, which will allow the system to improve margins and reduce leverage over time.' Proceeds were to refund the Series 2013A and 2013B bonds, finance capital projects, and for general corporate purposes; pro-forma debt outstanding ~$6.8 billion.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's press release titled 'Rating Action: Moody's assigns A2 to UPMC's (PA) Ser. 2023 and 2023A-1,A-2,B&C; outlook stable.' The Moody's landing page itself is paywalled (HTTP 403 anonymous), but the title is publicly indexed and the substantive content quoted above is recovered from search-result snippets. Date inferred from contemporaneous Bond Buyer / fiercehealthcare.com coverage of the March 2023 ~$1.6B issuance; exact day (2023-03-20) is the date typically cited as the press-release date in third-party indexes — flag as VERIFIED_DATE_APPROX (within March 2023) if exact day is required.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Assigned 'A' rating to UPMC Series 2023 obligations; affirmed 'A' on UPMC's outstanding obligations; outlook stable.
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P cited UPMC's leading position as an integrated regional delivery system in western Pennsylvania, revenue diversity from its large insurance arm (UPMC Health Plan), and broad operating footprint across Pennsylvania, western New York, and northwestern Maryland.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: UPMC's investor-relations page 'Bond Ratings and Disclosures' hosts the S&P letter on UPMC's Series 2023 bonds at the path /upmc-standard-poor-rating.pdf. The PDF binary cannot be decoded by WebFetch but the document title visible from the page index is 'University of Pittsburgh Medical Center's Series 2023.' Secondary coverage (Bond Buyer, fiercehealthcare.com) confirms S&P assigned/affirmed A with stable outlook on Series 2023 in March 2023. Exact day is UNVERIFIED — recorded as 'March 2023'.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Assigned 'A' rating to UPMC Series 2023, 2023A, 2023B (and parity outstanding) on new issuance; revised outlook to POSITIVE (from stable). $250 million of the deal that was anticipated for direct purchase was not Fitch-rated.
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch cited UPMC's leading market share in core western Pennsylvania markets, revenue diversity across multiple states (PA, western NY, northern MD), and the integrated insurance-provider business model. The positive outlook reflected expectations of continued margin improvement and balance-sheet strengthening.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: fiercehealthcare.com (March 2023): 'In March, Fitch Ratings assigned an A rating to the anticipated series of 2023 bonds (excluding a $250 million bond anticipated for direct purchase) and gave a positive rating outlook.' Corroborated by the Fitch letter title indexed on UPMC's IR page: 'Fitch Rates UPMC's (PA) Series 2023, 2023A, 2023B and ...' (dam.upmc.com/.../upmc-fitch-rating.pdf). Whether this constituted an explicit upgrade of the outlook from stable to positive vs. simple assignment of a positive outlook on a previously unrated/stable series is consistent with Fitch's March 2024 action language ('revised outlook from POSITIVE to stable'), which means a positive outlook was in effect through the period 2023-03 to 2024-03-19.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed 'A' Issuer Default Rating and 'A' revenue bond rating; revised outlook to STABLE from POSITIVE.
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Per Becker's Hospital Review coverage of Fitch's commentary, the outlook revision from positive to stable was based on 'challenging 2023 results' — UPMC reported a $198 million operating loss (-0.7% margin) in 2023, down from a $162 million gain (+0.6% margin) in 2022. Fitch noted UPMC forecast a 3.6% operating EBITDA margin in 2024 and expected budgeted results would be maintained longer term. Fitch cited UPMC's leading market share in core western PA, revenue diversity across PA / western NY / northwestern MD, and the large insurance division (55% of consolidated operating revenue in fiscal 2023) as offsetting strengths supporting affirmation of A.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Becker's Hospital Review (published on or about 2024-03-19, headline 'UPMC outlook revised to stable; 3.6% EBITDA margin projected for 2024' / 'Fitch revises UPMC's outlook after challenging 2023 results'). Direct fetch of the Becker's page returns HTTP 403; substance is reconstructed from search-engine result snippets that quote the article verbatim on the date, prior outlook, rating affirmed, EBITDA-margin projection, and rationale. The 2024-03-19 date is consistent across multiple snippets returned for the article.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed 'A' rating; revised outlook to NEGATIVE from STABLE (ahead of UPMC's March 2025 bond deal).
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch cited two consecutive years of significant operating losses — UPMC reported a -0.7% operating margin in 2023 and a -1.1% operating margin in 2024 (operating loss of $338.9 million). The negative outlook reflected the possibility of continued operating underperformance and uncertainty around the trajectory of the insurance segment despite management's plan to return to profitability in 2025 via improved Medicaid rates effective 1/1/2025. Provider-side operations showed 'meaningful operational improvement,' which Fitch judged 'not sufficient to offset the significant challenges faced by the insurance division.'
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Bond Buyer (March 18, 2025): 'Fitch lowered its outlook on UPMC's A rating to negative from stable ahead of the bond deal.' Quoted Fitch Director Meggi Carr: 'While they may have fixed some of their problems, it doesn't mean that it's gone away.' Same article: 'Moody's Ratings: Affirmed A2 rating with stable outlook' and 'S&P: Affirmed A rating with stable outlook.' Becker's headline 'Fitch revises UPMC's outlook to negative after 2 years of significant losses' (indexed; HTTP 403 on direct fetch) corroborates. Exact day VERIFIED_DATE_APPROX as early-to-mid March 2025 (Becker's snippets reference a 'March 6 report'; Bond Buyer article published March 18, 2025).

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed A2 revenue bond rating; outlook stable. (Affirmed in conjunction with UPMC's March 2025 bond deal.)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's cited UPMC's leading academic medical center position in Pittsburgh, well-regarded clinical and research enterprise, significant revenue diversity, and substantial market share across a broad geography — consistent with the rationale used in subsequent (March 2026) affirmation.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Bond Buyer (2025-03-18): 'Moody's Ratings: Affirmed A2 rating with stable outlook.' Affirmation contextualized as part of the pre-pricing rating package for UPMC's March 2025 issuance.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed 'A' long-term rating and SPUR on UPMC's outstanding debt; outlook stable.
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P maintained the A/stable view on the basis of UPMC's market position, integrated payor-provider model, and revenue diversification.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Bond Buyer (2025-03-18): 'S&P: Affirmed A rating with stable outlook.' Affirmation accompanied UPMC's March 2025 issuance.

moodys.citation_text: Bond Buyer (2025-03-18) confirms Moody's affirmed A2 with stable outlook in connection with UPMC's March 2025 deal; no later Moody's action through 2025-03-31 located.

sp.citation_text: Bond Buyer (2025-03-18) confirms S&P affirmed A with stable outlook in connection with UPMC's March 2025 deal.

fitch.citation_text: Bond Buyer (2025-03-18): 'Fitch lowered its outlook on UPMC's A rating to negative from stable ahead of the bond deal.' Negative outlook in effect at 2025-03-31; was not revised back to stable until Fitch's March 5, 2026 action (outside this window).

outcome_class_rationale: Across the 2023-01-01 to 2025-03-31 window, no agency downgraded UPMC's rating level. Letter ratings were stable at Moody's A2 / S&P A / Fitch A throughout. The trajectory in OUTLOOKS, however, was decidedly negative: Fitch went POSITIVE (entering 2023, reaffirmed March 2023) -> STABLE (revised 2024-03-19 after a -0.7% operating-margin year) -> NEGATIVE (revised March 2025 after a -1.1% operating-margin year). Moody's and S&P held STABLE outlooks throughout, including reaffirming stable in March 2025. As of the window-end snapshot, UPMC carries one rating with a negative outlook (Fitch) and two with stable outlooks (Moody's, S&P), with no level downgrade — so the bucket is AFFIRM_NEGATIVE_OUTLOOK rather than DOWNGRADE or MULTI_DOWNGRADE. IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO HAND-CURATED OUTCOME: The originally claimed 'Moody's downgrade to A1 from Aa3' did NOT occur within this window. That downgrade is real but dates from 2017 (the PinnacleHealth-acquisition cycle); a subsequent Moody's action took UPMC from A1 to A2 sometime between 2017 and the March 2023 affirmation. Within the 2023-01-01 to 2025-03-31 window, Moody's took NO rating-level action on UPMC — it affirmed A2/stable in both March 2023 and March 2025. The original hand-curated outcome should be corrected to AFFIRM_NEGATIVE_OUTLOOK driven by Fitch's outlook trajectory, not by a Moody's downgrade.
